symptom: describe microflow's non-nesting decision warning ended '(mxcli #923, interleaved)'; in the ako/mxcli fork #923 is 'MCP backend: CREATE ENTITY stores every attribute as String(200)', unrelated. The unrepresented-merge warning, the NORMALIZED note and the `mxcli syntax` text carried the same bare citation.
cause: User-facing strings cited an issue number without its owner; the code comments around them already said mendixlabs/mxcli#923, but the emitted text did not.
insight: Any issue number printed to a user must be owner-qualified: the binary ships from two repos with independent numbering, so a bare #N points at the wrong issue for half the readers. grep '"[^"]*#[0-9]' over non-test Go finds the emitted ones; comments are fine as long as the nearest one names the owner. Historical bug reports and findings quoting the old output were left as quotes.
